summary: sextant-cli-linux-arm64 ships a Go binary implementing a WebSocket/WebRTC-relayed PTY remote-control agent and Anthropic credential harvester
details: The linux-arm64 platform package ships `bin/sxt`, a Go binary linking pion/webrtc, pion/turn, pion/ice, pion/dtls, coder/websocket and a pty subsystem, with a hardcoded relay endpoint `wss://relay.sextant.top`. The shape is a remote-shell agent: an author-controlled relay drives a local PTY on the installer's host, providing full interactive shell access. The binary also contains an Anthropic secret-key regex `sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}` and references to `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=` and `https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models`, targeting `sk-ant-...` credentials from installers who use Claude Code. Host/network fingerprinting is performed via `http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,isp,org,as,proxy,hosting,mobile,query`, collecting geolocation, ISP, ASN, and proxy/hosting/mobile flags. The binary also references `https://claude.ai/install.sh`, `apt-get install`, `.bun/bin`, and an npm registry lookup for `sextant-cli/latest`, providing install-script orchestration under remote-relay control. The package's `package.json` declares its license as `SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control` — a repository named `claude_control` under a handle prefixed `ddos`, corroborating the remote-control purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
